title: kbmon's cleanup metrics (mon_export.cleanup_points) export only the verdicts remove and keep, so rows with the verdict ask are missing from kbmon.cleanup.leftovers
goal: mon_export.cleanup_points emits a kbmon.cleanup.leftovers point with verdict ask beside remove and keep, and kb/_self/monitoring.md lists ask among the verdicts of the metric

run: import sys; sys.path.insert(0, "_tools"); import mon_export as m; pts = m.cleanup_points({"counts": {"worktree": {"remove": 0, "keep": 0, "ask": 2}}}); sys.exit(0 if any("ask" in str(p) for p in pts) else 1)
import sys; t=open("kb/_self/monitoring.md",encoding="utf-8").read(); i=t.find("kbmon.cleanup.leftovers"); sys.exit(0 if i>=0 and "ask" in t[i:i+200] else 1)

clauses.clause: mon_export.cleanup_points emits a kbmon.cleanup.leftovers point with verdict ask beside remove and keep
kb/_self/monitoring.md lists ask among the verdicts of the metric
